description: This file is the main frontend source component for a React Native Tic Tac Toe game implementing a two-player local gameplay interface. It includes UI components, game logic, animations, and styling.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main functional component for the Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, rendering UI elements, animations, and controls.

methods.name: PlayerPill
methods.description: Component displaying player label with active state styling.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Component rendering a 3x3 grid with game cells, lines, and highlighting winning combinations.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Component representing an individual cell with animated press feedback and game symbol display.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: Reusable styled button component with primary and ghost variants.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Function determining if a game has a winner based on the board state.

methods.name: getWinningLine
methods.description: Function returning the indexes forming the winning line for a given board state.
